question: What is the prescribed action after completing one hundred thousand repetitions of the forehead-syllable mass?
premises: the forehead syllable mass is situated
one hundred thousand is to be done
inference: the ritual prescription is completed by worship after the count
uncertainties: exact referent of kṛtya is unclear
grammatical case of sura+arcite is uncertain
plain_english: Having situated the mass of syllables on the forehead and completed one hundred thousand, O worshipped god.
